evidence.reason: Moved tag validation into prepare() so verify_target runs on the HEAD SHA read under tick_lock (apps/crq-python/ops/prepare-host.py:643) before rendering, closing the race where a switch between the removed CLI check and the lock made prepare render from a commit the tag does not name, and updated the two direct test call sites in test_host_config_prepare.py and test_host_config_units.py to pass annotated tags naming HEAD; local tests were not run because the harness permits only git inspection commands, so correctness was established by inspecting the owned diff.
